pivotSpace: pixel-edge coordinates, origin at the bottom-left corner of one frame cell, x right, y up
frameLayout: one horizontal strip per animation; frame i occupies x = i*cell.w .. (i+1)*cell.w, full height; no padding
flip: none: Unity draws both without flip (AdamArtWorld: glow first, then the book, at the same point)

palette.name: master-v0.3
palette.rule: art 03 master palette only, unchanged; no new colours

assets.design: no closed outline and no corners: irregular warm light off the book's upper edge, fading down the sides by mid-height, none under the book, within 3 px of the book and a radius 10.8 circle; two single-pixel motes beside the book, none at a corner. Static, no blinking. Off in lowFX (Unity skips optional-fx when optional effects are off).

footprint.rule: each frame's opaque bounding box stays inside the current frame's box, so the shown size does not grow
